tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Renders a public web page in a real headless browser (JavaScript runs, redirects are followed) and returns it as clean markdown, a PNG screenshot or a PDF. One call, one payment, no account. A render that fails is not charged. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC (x402).

tools.name: host_file

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: host_file, schedule_callback · Private data: host_file · Public sink: host_file, schedule_callback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: host_file, schedule_callback · Private data: host_file · Public sink: host_file, schedule_callback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
